notice: All six CSV tables and accounts.json are invented teaching data, not official statistics.

value_added.csv.scope: one domestic production chain; no product-tax valuation adjustment

goods.csv.unit: prices: toy currency per unit; quantities: units per period
goods.csv.scope: two domestic final goods; fixed base-price volume example

producer_prices.csv.unit: prices: toy currency per unit; fixed base quantities
producer_prices.csv.scope: independent producer basket, not official PPI weights

labour.csv.unit: persons in a common eligible survey population
labour.csv.scope: synthetic population; no national demographic estimate

quarterly.csv.unit: toy output per quarter at common teaching prices
quarterly.csv.scope: invented seasonality and annual step changes

vintages.csv.scope: two fictional publication snapshots, distinct from quarterly.csv

accounts.json.scope: independent aggregate economy; G excludes public investment, I includes all capital formation

factorNormalization: Divide the four pattern factors by their arithmetic mean before adjustment.
